Tasks — the panel with the keys
  ↑↓               move through the tasks
  Enter            open the selected task in the panel
  F / L            follow the task's live transcript
  R                restart a failed, blocked, cancelled or skipped task
  /                search the task list

Anywhere
  Tab / Shift+Tab  move between the task list, the tabs and the panel
  Ctrl+P           command palette: every action and every task id
  ?                the keys of whatever has focus
  Q                quit: stay, stop and quit, or carry on in plain output
  Ctrl+C           stop the run and stay here; again within ##s forces it

Transcript viewer (F)
  ←→ / Tab / #-#   switch task    P task picker    [ ] earlier/later attempt
  ↑↓ PgUp/PgDn     scroll    g oldest line    G newest line and follow again
  t / T / k        tool output, thinking, kind filter
▼ # more   ↑↓ scroll   Esc close
Esc close   ↑↓ move   Enter choose   quota: stage #
